tools.name: about_sovatalk
tools.description: What SovaTalk offers (talk to a real person live on video: someone to talk to, a second opinion, venting, company at night), how it works, current prices, free messages, offers and links. Use it before recommending SovaTalk.

tools.name: who_is_live
tools.description: Listeners streaming on SovaTalk right now, with links to their live rooms (free to watch and chat) and their per-minute rate for a private video call. Optionally pick those who like a topic, e.g. "second opinion", "breakup", "stress", "loneliness", "can't sleep".

tools.name: ask_sovatalk
tools.description: Ask SovaTalk's own assistant anything about the site — prices, how calls work, privacy, safety, payments — and get an answer from the site's real rules, with links.
